purpose: Project the public Senior Attention workflow into bounded Google Workspace runtime guidance without creating a second fact system, a Google-specific task Skill, or a private execution plane.

direction_fit.beneficiary: a downstream Senior Attention pilot integrator and accountable engineering owner using approved Google Workspace surfaces
direction_fit.observable_state_change: one canonical public adapter contract makes Gem, Workspace Studio, and Notebook boundaries explicit before any private source binding or runtime-specific rendering
direction_fit.verification: Draft 2020-12 schema validation plus deterministic semantic tests for target coverage, candidate authority, product assumptions, and public/private boundaries
direction_fit.existing_capability_gap: the Senior Attention workflow and profile define task semantics, but no public contract currently constrains Google runtime surfaces, authority ceilings, source binding, or account-specific availability assumptions
direction_fit.current_evidence: public Lattice contracts and the Google Workspace adapter research guide; no private runtime observation is represented by this manifest
unknowns: which Gem surfaces are enabled in a specific downstream Workspace account
which Workspace Studio features and source scopes are enabled by downstream administrators
whether a private pilot reduces Senior reconstruction or review time
whether the three Google surfaces preserve citations and source coverage consistently in the target account
direction_fit.next_use: render bounded Gem, Workspace Studio, and Notebook projections, then bind them only inside a private manual or shadow pilot

non_goals: create a Google-specific Senior Attention mega Skill
create a new Agent or active module
treat a Gem as the only Google Workspace entry
treat Workspace Studio skills as Lattice Skill packages
treat Notebook synthesis as verified system truth
copy company Gmail, Drive, Chat, code, people, or live cases into public Lattice
grant automatic send, write, merge, release, deploy, or promotion authority
claim real downstream adoption, attention savings, or business value from public conformance
